name: QiYi Windmill Cube (Tiled - Icy Amber)
description: The QiYi Windmill Cube (Tiled – Icy Amber) is a striking 3x3 shape-mod that features a windmill-like shape on the top and bottom faces. The semi-transparent icy amber tiles give the puzzle a sleek, crystal-clear appearance while maintaining a traditional color scheme for easy piece identification. The slightly rotated layers offer a fresh challenge as you solve this visually captivating cube.
